reviews.review:
[h1]Experienced on the Meta Quest 3[/h1]

You can view my gameplay & early impressions here: https://youtu.be/wVTCoGl0yeg

I had fun. The game is very rough around the edges though. It needs more polish and a little bit more immersion in some critical areas. However, for the budget price, it's more than okay.

When I saw this game, I thought it would be a simple dentistry game that is more arcade than anything else. I thought maybe it was a comedy game. However, the game actually teaches some basic dentistry. I definitely learned a few things after playing this game. 

Is it the most realistic game? No. You'd be silly to think that a $15 game could teach you to be a real life dentist in VR. However, it may be a substitute for the first week of dental school. You do some tooth extractions. You learn about keeping the equipment clean and the different tools involved. You also learn all about anesthesia. The best part was getting to use the laughing gas. 

If you do well enough, you can unlock a big hammer to do some real damage. So the game doesn't take itself too seriously. Game is running on the Unity Engine. On my RTX 5090, I was getting a steady 90 fps. Game has full locomotion and snap turning. However, I didn't see smooth turning or any graphics options. Also, I didn't see a way to calibrate height or a play seated option, so I had to play standing.

[b]Rate 6/10.[/b]

[quote]I bought this game! If you enjoyed my review, please consider joining my Steam Curator group [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/Oculus_WMR]Oculus Rift Reviews.[/url][/quote]
